history.summary: A compact 603 sqft freehold 2BR in D14 at $1625 PSF / $980k near Aljunied. The headline ~7.2% URA CAGR is eye-catching but rests on just 10 transactions, and the asking PSF is ~4% above the $1559 project median.
history.rating_rationale: Attractive sub-$1M freehold 2BR quantum with a deep entry-level buyer pool and a young 2014 build. But the ~7.2% CAGR is built on only 10 txns — too thin to trust as a forward rate — and the asking is ~4% over the project median. 603 sqft is small for a 2BR (compact layout), limiting family resale appeal. Solid affordable entry but the growth claim is unreliable and there's no discount — Neutral.
red_flags: ~7.2% CAGR on only 10 URA txns — statistically unreliable, likely overstated
603 sqft is small for a 2BR — compact, narrower family resale appeal
8-min walk (710m) to MRT — not a doorstep location
catalysts: Sub-$1M freehold 2BR — broad affordable buyer pool

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: A sub-$1M freehold 2BR near Aljunied rents readily to couples and sharers; optically healthy yield on the low quantum, though a 603 sqft layout caps rent ceiling.
